spec.title: CLI expanded live smoke and Windows credential isolation
preconditions: Use the exact reviewed FAL-311 PR candidate with npm ci and a supported Node version.
The QA operator has an approved staging API URL ending in /v1 and a dedicated QA API key through the approved private runtime; never paste it into evidence.
Run on macOS and Windows; preserve the caller's existing CLI settings and OS credential store. No production target, account write or paid lookup is permitted.
steps: Run npm run check and npm run test:package. Verify the built-CLI integration tests and the unchanged package baseline pass.
Without DM_API_URL, then without DM_API_KEY, run npm run smoke:live:coverage. Each attempt exits 1, names the missing variable, makes no API request and prints no key.

On the approved staging target, run npm run smoke:live:coverage on macOS and Windows. Verify all five Commands pass: version, account, filters, fields and property-search cost estimate; request source and User-Agent checks pass and no records or charged credits are returned.

Confirm the caller's saved CLI configuration and OS credential-store entries are unchanged and the smoke's temporary directory is removed. Record the operating system, Node version, source commit, target environment and redacted command results.
spec.expected: Every command, isolation and cleanup assertion passes on the exact candidate on both operating systems. Missing configuration refuses before network use. Only four read-only API requests occur; property search uses estimate_cost. Live proof stays separate from the synthetic integration test and original three-Command Factory baseline. Any missing platform, credential or failed step remains unverified.
spec.executionReason: The expanded command is not a commissioned Factory automated task. Human QA must verify its dedicated staging credential and Windows OS-store isolation before adoption.
